_source.authority: Maharashtra Manual of Office Procedure, 2023 — Appendix 10.6, 'FORM OF GOVERNMENT RESOLUTION'
note: Section order and mandatory-ness come from the Manual — it is normative.
The `corpus_rate` on each section is how often that section is detectable in 1,500 random
Marathi GRs from the mahGRs corpus. It is DESCRIPTIVE, never a pass mark: signature blocks
read 30.4% only because they are scanned images, not because real GRs lack them.
Rules are enforced on drafts we generate, not used to judge historical GRs.
_source.layout: Alignment set 2026-08-01 on the officer's instruction: subject right; Government of Maharashtra title, department and Mantralaya address centred; everything else left. Section ORDER remains Appendix 10.6.

hint.en: One line stating what the resolution is about.
Departmental file number. Not a unique GR identifier — 41% of GRs share theirs.

sections.mop: Read.-Government Resolution, ____ Department No. ____ dated the ____

hint.en: Enumerated prior orders this resolution rests on. Every entry is checked against the corpus.
hint.mr: संदर्भाधीन पूर्वीचे आदेश. प्रत्येक संदर्भ संचिकेत तपासला जातो.

hint.en: SRS FR-11 orders the preamble Background -> Reference -> Resolution.
The operative decision, then numbered paragraphs 2., 3., ...

sections.mop: The expenditure should be debited to- ______

hint.en: Required only when the GR sanctions expenditure (SRS FR-11). Budget head like 2054-00-101-02.
hint.mr: खर्चास मान्यता देणाऱ्या निर्णयांसाठीच आवश्यक. लेखाशीर्ष उदा. २०५४-००-१०१-०२.

sections.mop: This resolution issues with the concurrence of the Finance Department on its unofficial reference No.____ dated ____

hint.en: Manual 9.5(6): mandatory where expenditure requires prior Finance reference under rule 11 of the Maharashtra Rules of Business (Article 166).
hint.mr: खर्चाच्या बाबतीत वित्त विभागाचा पूर्व संदर्भ आवश्यक असल्यास.

label.en: By order and in the name of the Governor of Maharashtra,
label.mr: महाराष्ट्राचे राज्यपाल यांच्या आदेशानुसार व नावाने,

sections.mop: By order and in the name of the Governor of Maharashtra,

hint.en: Corpus rate is 2.2% because this sits in the scanned signature image, not the text layer. The Manual requires it; enforce on drafts.
hint.mr: स्वाक्षरी प्रतिमेत असल्याने संचिकेत क्वचित आढळते; मसुद्यात आवश्यक.

sections.mop: _______  Under Secretary to the Government of Maharashtra, ____ Department.

hint.en: Manual 10.x: use the widest collective designation; do not include officers not concerned.
Not in the Manual, but 38.8% of real GRs carry it. Advisory only.

mr: मादाम कामा मार्ग, हुतात्मा राजगुरू चौक
सदर शासन निर्णय महाराष्ट्र शासनाच्या www.maharashtra.gov.in या संकेतस्थळावर उपलब्ध करण्यात आला आहे.
महाराष्ट्राचे राज्यपाल यांच्या आदेशानुसार व नावाने,
